tasks.prompt: Start at https://www.ikea.com/us/en/cat/desk-lamps-20502/. Find two different desk/work lamps priced under $40 USD each. Open the product pages and compare selected color, price, whether a bulb is included or integrated, and the shown delivery/stock wording. Select the cheaper lamp. In this isolated guest session add one to the shopping bag, verify correct product and quantity in the bag, change quantity to 2, verify the item subtotal with code, then remove your test items and verify the bag is empty. Do not add accessories or memberships. If delivery location is needed, use test ZIP 10001 and label it as a test location, not the user location. Capture a cart screenshot before removal and source.png after removal. Report each attempted step and its observed outcome.

Start at https://www.bestbuy.com/. Use site search and filters to find two different Logitech wireless mice under $50 USD, sold by Best Buy (exclude third-party marketplace sellers). Verify the exact selected color/model, displayed price, Bluetooth versus USB receiver support, and shown shipping/pickup wording from product pages. Recommend the cheaper mouse that explicitly supports Bluetooth; if none qualifies say so. Add one recommended mouse to the guest cart without protection plans, memberships or accessories; inspect the cart product, seller, quantity, price, and available fulfillment. Use test ZIP 10001 only if required for location. Report shipping/tax as unknown if not shown; never equate item subtotal with delivered total. Remove the test item and verify empty cart. Capture cart.png before removal and source.png after removal. Do not start checkout.

Start at https://www.uniqlo.com/us/en/. Use the store UI to locate an adult short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt priced no more than $30 USD. On its product page choose BLACK in size M and verify that exact variant is available; if unavailable, report it and do not silently substitute another variant. Read fabric composition and size-guide chest/body-width measurement including units and whether it is body or garment measurement; do not infer fit. Add exactly one of the verified variant to the guest bag, verify color/size/quantity/price in the bag, then remove the item and verify the bag is empty. If no qualifying available variant can be found, explain the evidence. Capture bag.png before removal and source.png after removal. Do not start checkout.

suffix: This is an authorized shopping evaluation in a fresh isolated guest browser. You may search/filter/sort, choose variants, dismiss routine cookie notices, enter test ZIP 10001 if needed, and add/change/remove only your own guest-cart test items. These reversible cart edits are authorized; describe their actual effect accurately. Never log in, use the vault, supply personal/contact/payment data, subscribe, reserve inventory through a booking flow, place an order, or submit a payment. Do not bypass access blocks or CAPTCHA. If blocked, stop that path and report the exact observed blocker. Use browser_* tools for all website access; sandbox_run only for arithmetic and saving artifacts, never network access. Save /workspace/out/findings.json with {findings,evidence}; findings must contain products (name,variant,priceUSD,url and relevant product facts), selectedProductUrl, steps (operation,attempted,completed,observedOutcome), cartVerified, quantityChangeVerified (null if not requested), cartEmptied, fulfillmentText, and blockers. Evidence is an array of short verbatim {claim,quote,url} from observed pages. Save /workspace/out/report.md with outcome, uncertainties and sources. Browser screenshot artifacts are separate from sandbox files. Return present_result with evidence links and artifacts. Mark verified only if the requested shopping flow actually completed; partial findings should remain clearly partial. Recheck the UI after actions; a successful tool call alone does not prove cart state.
